standing: Independent review, not author continuation and not root acceptance. Design/reference evidence only. It does not claim production, runtime, provider, browser, generator, performance or Run replay qualification. findings.area: S2 identity / historical retention / unknown states (RP-DO-05, RP-DO-10)
findings.title: The proposed required parameter row makes every retained evaluator3 Run without it inadmissible, so 'historical Runs stay admitted and show not-plan-bound' cannot happen under the owner model
findings.claim: contract.md section 7 and owner/identity-parameter-registry-patch.v1.json#/identityEffects/historicalRuns say predecessor Runs stay admitted under their own profile with entryRecognition.state=not-plan-bound. They also say no closed vocabulary is widened: the row uses the existing requiredForEvaluatorMajors:[3].
ownerLaw: docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/identity-model.v3.py:147-187 admit_parameter_selection: 'Pure over the parameters array ... the pre-Plan boundary and retained Run closure can both call exactly this'. It refuses EVALUATOR_REQUIRED_PARAMETER_MISSING for EVERY registry row whose requiredForEvaluatorMajors contains 3 (lines 183-186). There is no profile or generation dispatch.
docs/coop/design-corrections/foundation/identity-schemas.v3.json x-opensip-payload-registry/classes/parameter: the required-row vocabulary is keyed only by evaluator major.
findings.reproduced: evidence/probe-owner.json P1. The pinned identity-model.v3 admits the current required selection (enumeration-plan + evaluator-emission-plan). With the S2 row applied in memory only, the SAME selection is 'REFUSED EVALUATOR_REQUIRED_PARAMETER_MISSING:foundation/framework-recognition-plan.schema.v1.json'. A selection that includes the parameter is admitted. The model has one required-row dispatch site and no profile-version dispatch.
findings.consequence: recognition_custody 'not-plan-bound' (reference_model.py:722-726) can only come from the synthetic World flag recognition.planBound (build_fixtures.py:137). Real retained evaluator3 Runs would fail closure instead of degrading to unknown. RP-EV-INT-IDENTITY's 'under the successor profile' names a dispatch that does not exist. Adding it is a vocabulary/semantics change the patch says it does not make.
findings.fix: Choose and state one owner mechanism: (a) a profile/generation-qualified requirement (e.g. requiredFromProfile) with an identity owner successor and a predecessor-profile admission test; (b) keep the row optional (no requiredForEvaluatorMajors) and define absence as not-plan-bound at the report; or (c) a new evaluator major. Execute the choice against identity-model.v3 admit_parameter_selection and close_run with a retained predecessor Run fixture. Correct identityEffects.closedVocabularies.

findings.area: RP-DO-10 test origin incompleteness / absence claims / cross-universe calls
findings.title: Test reach ignores origins in other universes, so no-static-path-within-bound is emitted with no blockers while a recognized test calls the subject
candidateCode: reference_model.py:1053 hits keep only reach endpoints with endpoint.universe == target.universe
reference_model.py:1017-1025 test_blockers looks only at countBasis, limitations and the TARGET universe's origin set
reference_model.py:1037-1039 an origin set is derived only for the subject's universe
ownerLaw: query-projection-contract.v3.md section 3 table: calls@resolved-callee universe rule admitted-target, so callers can be in another universe
prototype-report-inventory.md:67 (R07) 'Bind metrics and test reachability to the exact universe/identity and show unknown values'
findings.reproduced: evidence/probe-candidate.json C1. The integration world, with the test file moved to its own tsjs unit/program 'tests' (vitest-jest recognized, schema-valid records). The call fact goes tests universe -> src/helper.ts#helper. The reach walk returns the test symbol at depth 1. That universe's origin set is declared and contains the symbol. Yet the helper row is 'no-static-path-within-bound' with no blockers. It is accepted by the patched schema and by admit_symbol_evidence. The unmodified baseline gives static-path-from-test-origin.
findings.mutationEvidence: M4 (remove the universe filter) survives check.py with CHECK OK: no fixture reaches a cross-universe caller.
findings.fix: Derive origin sets for every universe that occurs among the reach items (bounded by the walk), and match origins per universe. If any reached endpoint's universe has no declared set, add a blocker (e.g. test-origin-set-partial or a new foreign-universe-origin-set-not-declared). Embed the per-universe sets used. Add the C1 counterexample as a fixture so M4 is killed.

findings.area: RP-DO-10 test origin completeness / S1 native recognition
findings.title: 'declared' TS/JS origin sets rest on vitest-jest default globs that ignore the jest configuration, which gives unsound no-static-path-within-bound
ownerLaw: docs/coop/design-corrections/native/native_evidence_model.v2.py:3544-3548 recognize_frameworks: when package.json has a 'jest' key (and no config file) it emits assurance declared, testGlobs ['**/*.test.*','**/*.spec.*','**/__tests__/**'] and unresolvedChoices []. native-evidence.md:2762-2774 FR-1..FR-5 give no completeness meaning to testGlobs

reproduced: evidence/probe-owner.json P2 jestPackageJsonWithCustomTestMatch: the pinned native model, given package.json {jest:{testMatch:['**/tests/**/*.it.ts'],roots:['<rootDir>/tests']}}, returns the default globs as declared with no unresolved choice. findings.area: S4 patch composition with other report obligations
findings.title: Exact before/after remove-rows ops do not compose with another obligation's exact ops on the same shared selectors; the check proves only set semantics
findings.candidateText: owner/report-projection-successor-patch.v1.json#/compositionWithOtherObligations claims the ops commute with other successors; check.py:378-388 tests a remove() helper that ignores before/after
findings.reproduced: evidence/probe-candidate.json C4. An RP-DO-11 (step-duration) patch built with the same exact-before/after discipline on the 8 shared selectors. Applying this patch then RP-DO-11 with check.py's own apply_patch gives 'REFUSED patch before mismatch /$defs/FeatureId/enum'. The reverse order is refused the same way.
findings.fix: Specify remove-rows as match-based, with preconditions 'every match present' and 'no other member changed', and verify before/after only against the pinned parent as a separate record. Alternatively publish a rebase law. Test both orders with a real second obligation's ops through the same applier.
